Summary of a fitted model with all parameters

summary.latentmix.Rd

summary() collects the model and its full parameter table (parameters()); its print method shows the model as print.latentmix() does, followed by every parameter with robust (MLR) standard errors, z statistics and p-values.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'latentmix'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.latentmix'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

Arguments

object

A latentmix model.

...

Ignored.

x

A summary.latentmix object.

digits

Number of decimal places.

Value

summary(): an object of class summary.latentmix, a list with model (the model) and parameters (the data frame of parameters(), or NULL when not available). The print method returns x invisibly.

Details

Standard errors are available for LCA, LPA, LCGA, GMM, multigroup and LTA models (for an LTA in the Mplus parameterisation, see parameters()).

See also

parameters(), lm_table() (what = "parameters")

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
# parameter estimates with robust standard errors for the 4-class ACE model
summary(lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 4))
